metadata.name: Rulkov Map
metadata.author: Rulkov, N.F.
metadata.description: Discrete-time map neuron — piecewise fast/slow 2D iteration (spiking-bursting)

dynamics.x: (alpha / (1.0 - x) + y + I) if x <= 0 else (alpha + y + I if x < alpha + y + I else -1.0)

extensions.silicon_cosim_note: At I=1.5 over 30 iterations, the hand model and both schema formats have exact state and crossing agreement; Q16.16 RTL reproduces the 10-event crossing vector while both state variables stay within 0.001 absolute error. All three fast-map branches execute ten times. Long-window spike-count parity is not used for this map class.
